rpg.dialog.title: 📖 What is RPG?
rpg.what.title: 🎲  WHAT IS RPG?
rpg.what.body: RPG (Role-Playing Game) is a collaborative storytelling game. One player takes on the role of Game Master (GM/DM — Dungeon Master) and narrates the world, characters and challenges. The other players portray their own characters and make decisions. Dice determine the outcome of actions — but the story is created by everyone together.
rpg.how.title: ⚔️  HOW DO YOU PLAY?
rpg.how.1.text: The Game Master prepares the setting: maps, music, monsters and secrets.
rpg.how.2.text: Players create their characters with attributes, skills and backstories.
rpg.how.3.text: The GM describes the scene; players declare what they do.
rpg.how.4.text: Dice are rolled — the result determines whether the action succeeds or fails.
rpg.how.5.text: The story advances, choices have consequences, and every adventure is unique.
rpg.vsvp.title: 🖥️  VIRTUAL RPG vs TABLETOP RPG
rpg.vsvp.physical.label: In tabletop RPG
rpg.vsvp.physical.text: you gather in person with rulebooks, dice, paper character sheets and miniatures. The experience is immersive and social, but requires everyone to be in the same place.
rpg.vsvp.virtual.label: In virtual RPG
rpg.vsvp.virtual.text: sessions happen online — via Discord, Zoom or dedicated platforms. Digital tools replace the physical ones: interactive maps, virtual dice, ambient music and tokens on screen. It's accessible from anywhere in the world, but requires more organisation and good tools to maintain immersion.
rpg.story.title: 💜  THE STORY BEHIND THIS PROJECT
rpg.story.part1: I started playing RPG in 2019 and quickly fell in love with it. In 2020, due to the pandemic, I had to move entirely to the virtual format. One of the tools that helped me most during that transition was
rpg.story.part2:
— a Brazilian platform dedicated to online RPG that was, unfortunately, discontinued. Losing that tool was frustrating, and it planted the seed to build something of my own: software designed specifically for Game Masters, with everything needed to run sessions with atmosphere, organisation and immersion.

DM - Dungeon Music was born from that need.
